title: yummy show-off portuguese meat braise
description: a rich and flavorful portuguese dish featuring tender beef short ribs and a sweet caramel sauce, cooked to perfection in a cataplana. this recipe makes a great show-off dish for special occasions.
instructions: season the short ribs with salt and black pepper. heat the oil in the cataplana over medium heat. add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
add the red wine and beef broth to the cataplana, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
add the tomato paste, cumin, and paprika to the cataplana. stir to combine, then add the short ribs back to the pot.
cover the cataplana and transfer it to the oven. cook for an additional 30 minutes, until the meat is tender and the sauce is rich and flavorful.
remove the cataplana from the oven and stir in the caramel sauce. serve the short ribs hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
let the short ribs rest for 10 minutes before serving, to allow the juices to redistribute.
serve the short ribs with the rich and flavorful sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
